summary: Compose explicit paired transaction scope and same-transaction capture-gap fencing for agent source integration.

replay.detail: No replay, backfill or automatic gap restoration. Scope completion does not publish a source cut or certify a collection.

schema.detail: Explicit capture installation adds managed/guarded metadata; explicit scope activation installs the foundation Views singleton gap trigger. Ordinary Store opens install none.

rules.detail: No claim admission, projection digest or registry rule changes.

compatibility.detail: No default provider map, collection protocol or generated client changes.

downtime.detail: No default startup work or activation; hooks are explicitly composed before source coverage attestation.

manual.detail: No default deployment action. Source owners must qualify complete schema, canonical/local dependencies, namespace binding and raw/DDL exclusions before agent activation.

recovery.detail: Gaps persist and fence availability without restoring Ready. Raw managed COMMIT remains unsupported and must fail the independent read gate. Source/IVM schema removal requires trigger uninstall before removal.
